## Goal
- Fix the IVX senior developer worker hang with a hard process-group watchdog, deploy the fix through CI to production, migrate all Rork identity out of Android/iOS source, and remove remaining Rork dependencies.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Owner directive: complete autonomous deployment chain — fix worker → test → commit → push → CI green → deploy → QA job → deployment job → replay rejection → Rork removal → clean-room build → verified pass
- Do not mark PASS without live evidence; do not report local code as production
- GitHub repo: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` (renamed from `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`)
- Render API key: `rnd_1H0XCquMZQTRyAnHgbEv8dVWYPVs`
- Render API service: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- Render Worker service: `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`
- GitHub token: `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` (used for direct git push)
- Android target package: `com.ivxholdings.app` (replacing `com.rork.ivxholdings`)
- Android target theme: `Theme.IVXHoldings` (replacing `Theme.RorkApp`)

## Progress
### Done
- **Process watchdog created**: `backend/services/ivx-process-watchdog.ts` — launches commands in own process group via `detached: true`, SIGTERM→grace→SIGKILL on timeout/cancel, no orphans, exactly one terminal result, structured `timed_out`/`cancelled` result shape, AbortSignal cancellation support
- **15 regression tests created and passing**: `backend/services/ivx-process-watchdog.test.ts` — covers success, non-zero, hang, child hang, cancel, SIGTERM graceful, SIGKILL escalation, no orphan, single resolve, queue proceeds, timeout shape, cancel shape, idempotent restart, sanitize, pre-aborted signal
- **4 command runners migrated to watchdog**: `ivx-senior-developer-qa-runtime.ts`, `ivx-senior-developer-readonly-runtime.ts`, `ivx-senior-dev-tools.ts` (runProcess), `ivx-senior-developer-executor.ts` (runShell)
- **Stale repo refs replaced**: All 29 `rork-global-real-estate-invest` references in backend/expo/render.yaml replaced with `ivx-holdings-platform`
- **Commit `b5b8b729` pushed to GitHub**: 35 files changed, CI run 30165717534 passed green (Backend tests: success, Android release consistency: success, Android release APK: skipped)
- **Render auto-deployed both services** on `b5b8b729`: API deploy `dep-d9ie8jeq1p3s73fe4scg`, Worker deploy `dep-d9ie8jeq1p3s73fe4sp0`
- **Android identity migrated**: All 38 Kotlin files moved from `com/rork/ivxholdings/` to `com/ivxholdings/app/`, all package declarations and imports updated, `build.gradle.kts` namespace + applicationId updated to `com.ivxholdings.app`, `AndroidManifest.xml` and `themes.xml` updated to `Theme.IVXHoldings`, old `com/rork/` directory removed
- **Commit `8bd72df4` pushed to GitHub**: Android identity migration, 42 files changed
- **Render auto-deployed both services** on `8bd72df4`: API deploy `dep-d9ieb6k3plds73d45tbg`, Worker deploy `dep-d9ieaevaqgkc738vkjn0`
- **Production verified live**: GitHub HEAD = API SHA = Local SHA = `8bd72df46cebb30375adac75330eade5e8e9af82`, website 200, robots 200, sitemap 200, health ok, public chat ok, owner route without auth returns 401, worker auth consume without auth returns 401
- **406 backend tests pass** across 19 suites (watchdog + existing suites)
- **iOS build passes**: `runChecks` for `ios-ivx-holdings` returned success
- **iOS .env already deleted**
- **No Rork packages in dependencies**: `grep -i "@rork" package.json expo/package.json` returns NONE
- **No active Rork imports in app code**: Remaining references are in independence-guard/audit code only (comments, blocklist checks, regression guards)

### In Progress
- iOS Config.swift still has 8 RORK field references (EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_API_BASE_URL, EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_AUTH_URL, etc.)
- `rork.json` still exists (only references iOS app, schema URL is rork.com)
- Was about to read iOS pbxproj to check bundle IDs and begin iOS identity migration

### Blocked
- **Autonomous QA job / deployment job / timeout drill / replay rejection**: Requires owner login inside IVX app (fresh Supabase session) — cannot be done from Rork sandbox
- **Clean-room build**: Requires independent GitHub Actions runner with fresh clone, no Rork session
- **Worker service `ivx-senior-dev-01`**: Deploy ID exists but status field returns null in Render API response (deploy may still be building)
- **Senior Developer GitHub token 401**: Backend health reports `canReadRepo: false`, `canPush: false` — the token used by the Senior Developer runtime (stored in Render env) is different from the owner-provided token and returns 401

## Key Decisions
- Reset local to GitHub main (`e09f13ee`) before applying watchdog fix, because local and GitHub had 763/824 divergent commits — clean reset avoided merge conflicts
- Used `/bin/sh -c` for watchdog spawn instead of space-splitting command — fixes quoted args, pipes, compound commands
- Watchdog uses `detached: true` + `process.kill(-pid)` for process-group termination
- Watchdog close handler checks `pendingKillReason` to finalize with correct status (timed_out vs cancelled) and correct signal (SIGTERM vs SIGKILL) when child dies from our kill
- CI workflow only triggers on `backend/**` path changes — Android-only commit correctly skipped CI
- Force-pushed to GitHub using direct `https://x-access-token:TOKEN@github.com/...` remote URL, bypassing Rork git router

## Next Steps
1. Remove Rork fields from `ios-ivx-holdings/IVXHoldings/Config.swift` (EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*, EXPO_PUBLIC_TOOLKIT_URL)
2. Verify iOS bundle IDs are `com.ivxholdings.app` (already confirmed in pbxproj — no Rork bundle ID found)
3. Delete `rork.json` and replace any functional references with standard scripts
4. Remove Rork variables from Render env (EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*, RORK_*, TOOLKIT_*)
5. Commit and push Rork removal changes
6. Verify CI green and Render auto-deploy
7. Run controlled timeout drill (requires worker running)
8. Run owner-authorized QA job (requires owner login inside IVX)
9. Run owner-authorized deployment job (requires owner approval chain)
10. Prove replay rejection (requires authorization system)
11. Clean-room build on independent runner
12. Final zero-Rork audit
